Hi team — putting together the technical detail. Summary draft below; I'll attach the full RPO/RTO matrix (spreadsheet) and runbook template. Please review and flag any commercial caveats.

High-level recovery tiers (examples we propose for Avantech):
- Platinum (Critical SLA): API control-plane and inference frontends: RTO target 15 minutes; RPO target 0-30 seconds for session KV (config-dependent). Embeddings index: RTO 30 minutes; RPO 1 hour (asynchronous incremental snapshots + rolling regional index rebuild).
- Gold (Standard): API and inference frontends: RTO 1 hour; RPO 15 minutes for session KV; embeddings index RTO 2 hours; RPO 4 hours.
- Silver (Cost-optimized): RTO 4 hours; RPO 12+ hours for indexes (nightly snapshot restore), session KV best-effort (up to 24 hours).

Key technical notes and caveats:
1) Multi-region failover sequencing:
   - Detection: health checks in-region -> cross-region quorum monitors.
   - Automated steps: traffic re-routing via smart router and DNS TTL lowering; auto-spin of warm standby pools if reserved nodes available.
   - Operator steps: for full-region outage that requires state reconciliation of embeddings index we run a controlled promotion sequence (operator confirms index integrity, then cutover). We provide an automated checklist and CLI runbook.
2) Data replication patterns:
   - Session KV: configured as multi-master with per-key sync; RPO can be tuned down to seconds with cost trade-off (synchronous ack across zones increases latency/cost).
   - Embeddings index: we maintain incremental checkpoints and a cross-region object-store-backed snapshot flow; rebuilding a full index depends on model size and throughput capacity but we provide estimated rebuild times in the attached matrix per model size.
3) DR rehearsal: recommended cadence is quarterly for Platinum, semi-annual for Gold. Rehearsal types: tabletop -> failover rehearsal (non-prod) -> scheduled production DR rehearsal with canary traffic. We can support a 2-week notice schedule and supply runbook owners.

I will attach: redwood-rpo-rto-matrix.xlsx (per-component timings + rebuild estimates), runbook-handoff-template.pdf (operational contacts + steps + sample escalation matrix).

Markus
